title: mentha canadensis var. glabrata
intro: Mentha canadensis var. glabrata, commonly known as American mountain mint, is a variety of the Mentha canadensis species, characterized by its glabrous leaves and stems. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of American mountain mint include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aromatherapeutic uses.
